tasks.title: Implement read-only network inventory and Windows event sources
acceptance: Typed bounded event contracts
Connection inventory with clear collection scope
Event source health and permission failures are visible
No system-changing actions
tasks.notes: Network inventory provides local interface counters/rates and up to 256 TCP endpoints. Event monitor now continuously samples 35 allow-listed v29 event IDs across 7 fixed Windows channels every 15 seconds while the service runs. Records contain bounded metadata only; raw event/script bodies are not collected. 4625 records are suppressed individually and aggregated into a HIGH alert at 10 events/300 seconds. Page has severity/search filters and explicit per-channel errors. Build/test: 0 warnings/errors; 36 tests pass including fixed source/event allowlist, classification, client bounds, burst threshold and current-user IPC round-trip. Remaining: v29 PowerShell Sigma/AMSI analysis, richer burst/rule detection, push subscriptions, normalized alert lifecycle, Sysmon/ETW, and source-to-detection parity. See docs/WINDOWS_EVENTS.md.

tasks.title: Implement durable configuration, history, and migration-safe local storage
acceptance: Transactional schema upgrades
DPAPI-backed secrets
Backup and restore verification
Privacy minimization
tasks.notes: Implemented first service-side persistence slice: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.12; schema-v1 operation projection and append-only transition events; transactional updates; WAL/FULL durability; fixed operation/state vocabulary; current actor SID; path-free bounded object IDs/reason codes; idempotency and restart-visible pending recovery; protected current-user/SYSTEM directory ACL; reparse checks; no action IPC or file/system mutations. 43 tests pass including ACL, migration/reopen, transition, rollback and recovery tests. Still missing retention/rotation, signed or independent tamper evidence, backups, alert/evidence history, and an isolated installed service identity. See docs/ACTION_JOURNAL.md.

tasks.title: Implement audited response broker and reversible protection actions
acceptance: Explicit allow-list and authorization policy

tasks.notes: Critical prerequisite before any destructive/system-changing feature. Define a versioned narrow action catalog, policy validation, explicit per-action consent, default-deny, dry-run preview, idempotency, bounded execution, structured audit, cancellation/timeout, and recovery. No arbitrary shell/command execution.
